[[File:LomPyke.png|thumb|right|[[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] leader [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke's]] face and hands were stained with Sansanna spice.]]

'''Sansanna spice''' was a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] that was hard to come by in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large, due in part to it being heavily taxed in some fourteen [[Star system/Legends|systems]]. As one of [[Ventooine/Legends|Ventooine's]] major exports it was regulated severely by the ruling [[Satab]]s. Unlike some spices, it was ingested directly into the mouth, resulting in the staining of addicts' face and hands. The [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] dealt with this spice, and its leader [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke's]] face and hands were stained by it.

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a crate filled with pure Sansanna spice was stolen, with many other items, on the transport taken by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. The ship was then boarded by a group of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] pirates, who found the crate of Sansanna spice and reported it to the group's leader [[Jiro/Legends|Jiro]]. Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a major source of it was traced by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to Ventooine, which triggered a sequence of events that led to the end of the Satab line.
